tagline: Kerupuk RHR Snack from Setu with documented one-ton production capacity and public retail availability.

story.title: Kerupuk RHR Snack from Setu with documented one-ton production capacity and public retail availability.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi Tangerang Selatan lists RHR Snack under Eti Nurhaeti in Setu, with one-ton production capacity and multiple kerupuk flavours. The listing records SPP-IRT, Halal LPPOM MUI, BPOM, HAKI and SNI where applicable. A Shopee listing also shows Kerupuk Ikan Tenggiri RHR Snack from a South Tangerang seller.
